title: vendor: bump imagebuilder for symbolic COPY/ADD --chmod; bud tests
body:
Fixes #6938.

## What

Vendors `openshift/imagebuilder` **dd621aba17a9** (imagebuilder PR #324, merged 2026-08-25), which makes the Containerfile `COPY`/`ADD` `--chmod=` path accept **symbolic modes**, restoring parity with the dockerfile frontend spec (numeric and symbolic are both part of the spec since Dockerfile syntax 1.14) and with `buildah copy/add --chmod=`, which already resolve symbolic values.

## Why

`checkChmodConversion` validated `--chmod=` as octal-only at dispatch time, so every symbolic form (`+x`, `u+x`, `a+rX,go-w`, ...) failed with `Error parsing chmod <mode>` before the executor ever saw it. That is the root cause of #6938: the execution layer was already symbolic-aware, but the parser vendored from imagebuilder rejected the instruction form. The issue includes a repro on released buildah 1.45.0 showing the CLI subcommand and the Containerfile instruction disagreeing on the same binary.

Semantics (from the vendored change): clauses are parsed by `mode.Parse` (the library the executor already uses) and resolved against each file's current mode, so the conditional `X` behaves correctly per file; octal values are now range-checked to 0-07777; word forms (`rwxrwxrwx`) are rejected with the same parse error as before.

## Tests

Two new bud cases alongside the existing chmod ones (`tests/bud/copy-chmod-symbolic/`):

- `u+x,go-rwx` on a plain 0644 source file -> `chmod:700`
- `a+rX,go-w` on an executable 0755 script -> `chmod:755` (X keeps the exec bit on an executable file)
- `--chmod=rwxrwxrwx` word form -> build failure (`Error parsing chmod`), exit 125 per the existing bad-Dockerfile convention

The mode-matrix was verified end-to-end in the imagebuilder PR (FROM-scratch builds with modes read back from the layer): `a+rX,go-w` on 0700 -> 755, `+x` on 644 -> 755, `u+x,go-w` on 644 -> 744, `u+rX-w` on 700 -> 500, `g+r=rx` on 644 -> 654; `888`, `0o755`, `17777`, `rwxrwxrwx` rejected.

## Verification on this branch

- `go build ./cmd/buildah` with the new vendor: exit 0 (golang:1.25.9, gpgme/btrfs dev headers).
- `go mod tidy` / `go mod vendor` clean; `vendor/modules.txt` updated to `v1.2.22-0.20260825193223-dd621aba17a9`.
- bats cases follow the neighboring `combined chown and chmod` pattern (`_prefetch alpine`, `WITH_POLICY_JSON`, `expect_output --substring`); the executable fixture is committed with its exec bit (`100755`) since the `a+rX` case depends on it.
